scope: Honc life capability extension on existing Hermes
verification_note: Passes refer to the stated behavior contracts verified by real backend/integration tests and production-model trajectories. Native Telegram adapter is connected and automatic silent ticks ran; isolated delivery callbacks are not claimed as real Telegram send receipts. The global mission gate remains pending_review.

features.behavior: Retain Hermes profile, agent loop and narrow tool permissions
verification: Boot an isolated honc profile with the real existing guard and Skills
Register a Direct Run and read domain status
Terminal, arbitrary recipient and other domain writes remain unavailable
No second agent runtime or mid-session toolset change

features.behavior: Trusted source and one logical write effect across retries
verification: Replay one real input with the same request_ref and payload; records and IDs stay identical
Changed payload on the same ref returns conflict
Other user/profile/session source is rejected
Two domains in one source have separate persistent receipts without duplicate facts

features.behavior: Configure, pause, resume and retire habits with retained historical versions
verification: Create an explicit habit and reject implicit creation through check-in
Update target with expected_revision; prior events keep old definition
Concurrent stale update conflicts
Retire hides active habit and preserves audit history

features.behavior: Preserve habit units, multiple occurrences and explicit outcomes
verification: 20 minutes remains duration rather than 20 completions
Breakfast and lunch remain separate instances
Negative, planned, queried or quoted activity does not produce completed check-in
Partial, skipped, not_done and unrecorded have distinct meanings

features.behavior: User-supplied body observations without proactive follow-up
verification: Record fatigue, pain and positive wellbeing with exact source
Unspecified part, score and time remain unknown
Do not create follow-up job, medical inference or body-change prompt
While a focus round runs, body recording preserves its ID and state

features.behavior: Diary retains user content and supplies one related habit check-in
verification: Save a diary and its text-habit reference atomically
Retry creates no extra diary or check-in
Body links do not duplicate the source observation
Backfilled yesterday diary does not complete today's instance

features.behavior: Wake at 08:00 or an earlier explicit day start, with one shared quota
verification: Explicit 07:00 wake/day start schedules the morning instance
08:00 tick does not repeat it
Race the anchor and tick from separate execution paths; one delivery operation
08:00 sends without a user chat and does not create a factual wake observation

features.behavior: 21:30 diary/body invitation once, without nightly unchecked-habit chasing
verification: Due bedtime invitation includes optional body logging
No reply does not produce extra reminder
Earlier unrecorded habits are absent from bedtime chase
Configured reminder count controls quota; importance does not add reminders

features.behavior: History query, approximate times, corrections and user isolation
verification: Yesterday and approximate time preserve source date and precision
Correct quantity without deleting original event
Effective aggregates use corrected value and units
Cross-user lookup, cursor and receipt cannot leak records
Unknown occurrence date remains explicit

features.behavior: Hermes reminder delivery and restart recovery retain actual receipts
verification: Exercise real Hermes no-agent scheduler and delivery adapter using isolated profile
Map reminder_id to native execution and delivery outcome
After restart do not re-send delivered or uncertain attempts
Unknown delivery stays unknown rather than successful
Lost fencing owner cannot submit another effect

features.behavior: Approved product policies for early completion, missed windows, grouping and bedtime
verification: Implement the explicitly accepted R1 through R4 policies
Prove full-instance completion suppresses only unsent corresponding reminders
Test start-inclusive/end-exclusive windows and 30-minute point grace
A grouped notification consumes each included instance quota once
Explicit early bedtime shares the 21:30 quota
Uncertain delivery is not replayed

features.behavior: Detailed manuals match tools and actual ordinary-model trajectories
verification: Validate documentation examples against actual schemas
Run versioned messages through the configured production-level model
Verify final records, operation IDs and replies for negation, ambiguity and partial success
Measure calls, failures and latency without switching to stronger model as acceptance shortcut

features.behavior: Non-destructive inheritance and staged migration of old habits and history
verification: Inventory original habit IDs, fields and record types without sending messages
Produce old-to-new mapping for user comments
Keep original raw data and IDs; never seed fabricated personal records
Unmapped ownership or units remain pending instead of guessed
Disable duplicate old/new reminder route at reviewed cutover with recoverable configuration
